Results and verificationMethods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Solve u_t = u_xx + u on [0, 1] with both boundary values equal to 1, an analytic steady state plus a 0.1 sine perturbation, and T = 0.1. Use 31, 63 and 127 interior nodes with 8, 16, 32 and 64 steps, plus four Lie controls: 28 runs.
